profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Microsoft
profile.summary: Software Engineer building AI evaluation infrastructure for M365 Copilot at Microsoft. Specializing in prompt engineering, LLM behavior analysis, and scalable quality systems for enterprise scenarios.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Part of M365 AI Experiences, building evaluation infrastructure for M365 Copilot Researcher across enterprise verticals including finance and legal.

Owning the Vertical AI Evaluation portal for the Finance vertical, from the eval runner backend to the web experience, enabling rigorous analysis, shareable insights, and surfacing gaps in our stack and vendor data quality. Driving end-to-end evaluation pipelines with token usage and cost tracking, failure mode analysis, and debugging views that help teams understand Copilot model behavior across prompt variations and prevent quality regressions. Leading the first end-to-end workflow for generating Microsoft CFO quarterly earnings reports using Researcher, iterating on prompts to deliver high-quality, partner-ready outputs. Consistently amplifying impact by helping other teams onboard to shared evaluation tooling, sharing rubric-extraction approaches across verticals, and unblocking partners through strong cross-org collaboration.

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
Part of M365 AI Experiences, building evaluation infrastructure for M365 Copilot Researcher across enterprise verticals including finance and legal.

Developing end-to-end pipelines that automate task evaluation with token usage tracking and failure mode analysis. Building debugging dashboards enabling teams to analyze model behavior across prompt variations and catch quality regressions. Designing intent classification frameworks that enable context-aware AI responses and establishing synthetic evaluation tasks as gold-standard test sets for domain-specific workflows.

positions.title: Software Enginner II
positions.description:
Part of M365 Intelligent Communication and Collaboration (IC3), delivering communication and collaboration services including core calling services and meetings. Focused on developer tooling, deployment automation, and distributed system reliability.

Built the OCE API Access Tool that auto-generates secure endpoints from Swagger files, adopted by 7+ teams across commercial and government clouds. Improved deployment quality scores by 122% (from 1.8 to 4.0 out of 5) through automated validation workflows with instant rollback capabilities. Led migration of 55+ build pipelines, reducing build times by 20% and cutting release cycles from 18 weeks to 2 weeks. Mentored junior engineers on security reviews and API design.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Microsoft LEAP Apprenticeship focused on big data infrastructure.

Built organization's first production data pipeline using Apache Spark on Azure Synapse, processing petabytes of GDPR-compliant data. Contributed to legacy system decommissioning, reducing operational maintenance costs.

positions.title: Teaching Assistant
positions.description: Supported students in advanced software development courses, reinforcing fundamentals in web development and API design while developing mentorship and communication skills.

volunteerExperiences.description: Key liaison between the senior and youth group service in communicating on current issues. Budget and allocate events funds to operate events throughout the year. Evaluate programming needs in church community and increase member intake through outreach efforts.

Collaborated work with other volunteers to increase attendance of annual orientation by devising innovative and cost effective promotional ideas despite reduced budget. Explored past strategic trends and developed analysis methodology to convince supervisor to address non-traditional audience and doubled amount of attendees. Reviewed and ensured that the procedure were in compliance with all required standard.

projects.title: Herokufy .NET
projects.description:
A proof of concept that an ASP.NET application with a relational database can be continuously integrated and deployed to Heroku!

Technologies used: C#, ASP.NET Core, Docker, Heroku, and Heroku Postgres

projects.title: Wake-on-LAN with Google Assistant
projects.description:
Wake-on-LAN with Google Assistant is a simple RESTful API built using Flask that turns on a WoL enabled computer.

Technologies used: Python, Flask, ngrok, If This Then This Webhooks, Google Assistant, Raspberry Pi
